description:
Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration, enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide, including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

About the Role:
You’ll build the operating engine that helps our team turn global campaigns into regional pipeline for EMEA and LATAM. Sitting between global strategy and regional execution, you’ll adapt enterprise messaging and resources for regional buyers, then run, automate, and improve the work behind them: campaign setup, intake, localization, reporting, and follow-up.

This is a hands-on role. Roughly half your time goes to running regional activation and operations well. The other half goes to automating, templating, and improving that work as a core part of how the team operates. You will work closely with the Global Integrated Campaigns team, Field Marketing, Marketing Ops, EMEA/LATAM sales leadership, ADRs, Product Marketing & Partner Marketing.

What you'll be doing:

Regional activation and localization

  •  Serve as the primary EMEA point of contact for the Growth Marketing teams (integrated campaigns, ABM, etc.), localizing company-wide programs for each sub-region and owning the regional campaign execution plan: goals, messaging angles, channel mix, and asset translation, all within brand standards.

  • Help activate ADRs and Sales on localized campaigns.

Campaign and program execution

  • Lead end-to-end local delivery across digital, email, social and ABM and collaborate with Field marketing on relevant industry events that are part of the overall campaigns. Manage timelines, vendors, and multi-channel coordination to hit regional pipeline targets.

  • Build and launch campaigns and events hands-on in HubSpot (emails, landing pages, forms, lists, workflows) and Salesforce (campaign build-out, list pulls, segmentation), to Marketing Ops standards. Act as Marketing Ops' primary liaison for regional field marketing.

  • Explore new vendors on behalf of the team and take them through Procurement.

Operating model and request intake

  • Run the EMEA field marketing request intake: triage against priority tiers and SLAs, and route or decline work that doesn't fit the plan. Partner with marketing operations on behalf of field marketing to leverage use of AI automation.

  • Design and maintain the localization workflow: translation tooling, a brand and terminology glossary, review routing, and vendor management.

  • Translate global campaign strategy into modular playbooks and campaign kits that each region can adapt without rebuilding from scratch

Budget, performance, and insight

  • Manage and forecast the regional campaign budget, and allocate it across channels and programs for maximum ROI.

  • Define regional KPIs (MQLs, cost per MQL, pipeline influence, revenue impact). Own reporting and attribution hygiene across regions, including data quality in Salesforce and HubSpot.

  • Measure the operational impact of your work: hours returned to the team, request cycle time, and campaign activation speed.

  • Bring local market feedback on competitors, customer needs, and emerging opportunities to Product Marketing, Global Campaigns, and leadership.

  • Partner with the Senior Field Marketing Managers to align the operating model with pipeline goals.

What you bring:

  • Ability and/or willingness to use our product.

  • 7+ years in B2B marketing, field marketing, or program operations, ideally in B2B software. You have a record of running integrated, pipeline-focused programs.

  • Hands-on experience as a Senior Field Marketing Manager (or equivalent regional field marketing role) running events, account-based campaigns, and sales partnership.

  • Strong hands-on skills in Salesforce and HubSpot (or a comparable CRM and marketing automation platform), including building campaigns and reporting on performance.

  • Demonstrated experience building automations with workflow tools such as Claude and Zapier, or with scripting that connects systems. You know how to apply LLM tools to real operational work and where human review is required.

  • Experience running multi-region programs, with an understanding of how regions and languages differ operationally.

  • Strong program management: organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable juggling many programs, vendors, and stakeholders at once.

  • A process-oriented, analytical mindset. You document what you build, measure what it does, and use data (A/B testing, attribution) to improve it.

  • Excellent written and verbal English. You can influence sales leaders, AEs, and senior marketers, and present to executives.

  • You are self-motivated, outcome-focused, and comfortable in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment.

  • Experience supporting field marketing or sales organizations in EMEA (LATAM a plus).

  • Experience managing budgets over €500K.

Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience with localization or translation management tools, or working with translation vendors.

  • Fluency in a second European or Latin American language.

  • Familiarity with ABM strategies and tools, and with event platforms and attendee data flows.

  • Experience marketing to enterprise or technical buyers (developers, architects, platform teams), or a background in automation, orchestration, or workflow software.

  • Experience mentoring a team.

What success looks like:

  • First 90 days: You complete a time audit with the Senior Field Marketing Managers, launch request intake with defined tiers and SLAs, and automate at least two recurring processes.

  • End of year one: The team is measurably faster on campaign launches. The Senior Field Marketing Managers spend more of their week on strategy and pipeline. You own a documented automation roadmap across EMEA and LATAM, and regional campaigns show a clear link to pipeline.

Why join us:

  • Impact: Your campaigns and systems directly drive Camunda's growth in EMEA and LATAM, and you see your work in pipeline and revenue reports.

  • Autonomy: Own execution, operations, and the automation roadmap for a high-growth region, with a collaborative global team behind you.

  • Growth: Work with strong marketing leaders, build AI-driven ways of working, and develop expertise across complex, multicultural markets.

  • Scale: Join a fast-growing company where your individual contribution shapes the trajectory in one of our most important regions.

What We Have to Offer:

Compensation

We offer competitive, fair, and transparent compensation. Salary ranges are location-based, with Standard and Major markets (global tech hubs) reflecting local competition.

The Annual Total Target Cash (base salary + 100% variable target, where applicable) shown below spans from the minimum in a Standard market to the maximum in a Major market. Final offers depend on skills, experience, and location, and we typically hire in the first half of the range to allow room for growth:

United States: $131,300.00 to $211,600.00

United Kingdom: £82,400.00 to £135,600.00

Singapore: S$163,000.00 to S$244,500.00

If you’re based elsewhere, you’ll be hired via Remote.com (our global employer partner), and your Talent Acquisition Partner will provide a personalized Total Rewards Calculator after your first interview.

Equity: We also offer equity (where applicable) through our Virtual Stock Option Plan (VSOP).

Benefits & Perks

We invest in your wellbeing, growth, and ability to connect, along with perks that support you no matter where you’re based. Our benefits are globally designed and locally delivered where applicable.

  • Remote & Flexible: Work from anywhere with the setup that suits you, home office budget, co-working space support, and flexible time off to recharge when you need it.

  • In Person Connection: We invest in meaningful face time through our Annual Kickoff (Vienna in 2025, Madrid in 2026!), team offsites, and Camundi Connection Budgets, including contributing to meetups while travelling,, and local gatherings with fellow Camundi.

  • Health & Wellbeing: Access locally tailored healthcare, Modern Health for global mental wellbeing, and our Live Well Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA), a flexible, global benefit that puts you in control of your whole life, not just work, from: staying active, to caring for family, exploring personal passions, meaningful experiences, and investing in your financial wellbeing. The Live Well program launches in 2026 and scales to €1,000 annually from 2027.

  • Financial Security: Retirement and pension plans (often with company contributions), plus life and disability insurance where relevant.

  • Professional Growth: Up to $/€/£1,000 per year for self-driven learning: courses, certifications, books, you decide!

AI in our hiring process: Camunda may use AI tools to aid the screening of applications and during the interview process. You can learn more here

”Everyone is welcome at Camunda” — it’s a celebrated component of our culture. We strive to create an inclusive environment that empowers our people. At Camunda, we honour diverse cultures and backgrounds and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to gender, race, ethnicity, religion, belief, sexual orientation, age, disability or any other protected characteristics under applicable law. We are looking forward to your application!

Come join us and be part of Camunda’s incredible journey: Make an impact at a pivotal moment in our story!

Please be aware that scammers may impersonate Camunda by reaching out about job opportunities. Camunda will only contact candidates from an email address ending in @camunda.com or @talent.camunda.com. We will never ask candidates for bank account details, checks, payment, or other sensitive financial information as part of our hiring process. If you receive a suspicious message, please do not respond, click any links, or share personal information.

Note for recruiting and placement agencies: Camunda does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our careers site, employees, or any other Camunda contact unless we have specifically engaged your firm for that search. Camunda will not pay fees related to unsolicited resumes.

For information about how your personal data is processed, please refer to Camunda’s Applicant Privacy Policy. We note that phone numbers and SMS opt-in data are not shared, sold, or rented to third parties or affiliates for marketing or promotional purposes.

By opting in to SMS use, please be aware that:

  • Text message frequency may vary;

  • Standard text message and data rates may apply; and

  • By opting in, you will be enrolled directly in ongoing recruiting text messages from Camunda.

To opt-out, simply select 'No' when prompted during your application. You can also change your preferences at any time by contacting talent-operations@camunda.com.
